drhp.business: The Company is primarily engaged in the business of printing, flexible packaging and paperboard activities, operating through three segments: Printing, Flexible Packaging and Paper Board Packaging. During the last fiscal year it diversified into the candle manufacturing business.
drhp.expansion: The Company has installed automatic Board to Kraft fluting Lamination Machines to promote eco-friendly packaging, aimed at enhancing its business opportunity in value-added printing and packaging and in the export market. It is keenly interested in inducting new technology to upgrade its existing facilities to remain a leading player in the printing and packaging industry.

risks.note: The Indian printing and packaging industry is not organized, with close to 1,20,000 units ranging from highly organized to very small proprietary units; this diversified structure exposes the Company to unhealthy competition affecting growth and profitability.

The Flexible Packaging and Paper Board Carton/Rigid Box divisions operated below production capacity during the year due to severe competition from the unorganized sector and un-remunerative selling prices.
risks.risk: Competition from the unorganized sector and unremunerative pricing

risks.note: Cost of raw materials such as wood pulp and recycled paper has been rising due to increasing demand from emerging economies, timber shortage and rising energy costs, pressuring the fragmented Indian paper industry.

The paper packaging industry is capital-intensive and often needs access to credit to finance operations, but credit flow to the industry is often inadequate, making it difficult for businesses to invest and grow.
risks.risk: Capital intensity and inadequate credit flow

risks.note: Rapid technological advancements, including single-pass digital printers, pose challenges for traditional printing businesses that rely on outdated equipment; investment in modern machinery is needed to stay competitive.

The Company's main thrust has shifted toward paper and paper board related printing and packaging specifically to safeguard its business against potential government legislation curbing plastic-related packaging on environmental grounds.
